  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: A queued→in_progress transition between sequential API calls can cause unique_by(.id) to retain the stale queued snapshot, misclassifying the active run and dispatching a duplicate review.
  WHY: The stale queued copy is removed from active despite the in_progress copy, violating the invariant that in_progress runs are never discounted; severity ranged from NIT to MAJOR, so MAJOR is used.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
